# THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE MALDEN HOUSING AUTHORITY

08/11/26

The regular meeting of the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) was held on August 11, 2026, at 8:30 AM at the office of MHA, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148. All votes are by roll call with remote Commissioners.

**COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING IN PERSON:** Willaim P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

**COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING REMOTELY:** Joan M. Chiasson and Emmanuel Marsh

**MHA STAFF:** Stephen G. Finn, Randy Waters and Barbara A. Hooley

**MHA STAFF ATTENDING REMONTELY:** Thomas P. Callaghan

## 1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 7-7-26

The Board reviewed the minutes of the 7-7-26 meeting.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the 7-7-26 meeting minutes.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### Y. SITE IMPROVEMENTS INC.—RESOLUTION 2026-09

The Executive Director presented the Board with a request in connection with the Capital Improvement plan that was previously approved. Quotes have been solicited for Paving the Driveway at the Springdale Development. The original estimated cost for this project was $57,000.00. NE RCAT has conducted this procurement by statute, and in accordance with all EOHLC regulations. The low bidder for this project is Site Improvements Inc. It is RCATS recommendation to accept the quote and enter into contract with Site Improvements for this project in the amount of $54,682.00

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Frank M. Molis and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To accept the recommendation of NE RCAT and approve low bid award and contract in the amount of $54,682.00 to Site Improvements, Inc. for MHA's Springdale Paving Reconstruction Project with cost to be paid by the State through CabHub. In approving the bid and awarding the contract to Site Improvements Inc, MHA expressly rejects the Low Bid of Oakridge Construction which bid was withdrawn from consideration by the Company, as well as the 2nd Low Bid of Madeira Construction with the Company's bid being determined "non-responsive" and therefore, each bid will not be considered for contract award.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

headline: Approved payments, wage increases, contract change orders, and donations covering utilities, construction projects, insurance renewals, and charitable requests.
summary: The board approved payment of numerous invoices and change orders, including $1,579,171.08 for Section 8 HAP and MRVP registers, up to $800,000.00 for FY2027 insurance renewals, and $54,682.00 for the Springdale Paving Reconstruction Project. It also approved several donations, including $250.00 to The Bread of Life, $1,800.00 for Malden Public Safety Day, and $150.00 in memory of former Commissioner Barbara Purcel.
